title: cpu wheel pip index issue
bug_description: Using the url given for cpu wheels (https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu), results in the links going to the regular pytorch index. This causes installs giving that index url to fail to install cpu wheels. They still seem to be available if using eg. `--find-links` with the direct path https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch This was working a couple of days ago. cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @seemethere @malfet @atalman
